content.text:
Confirmed by `src/docs/detecting-classes-in-source-files.mdx` (lines 67–74): Tailwind scans source files as plain text and can't understand string interpolation, so `bg-[url('{{ Vite::image(...) }}')]` doesn't produce a complete, unbroken class string at scan time — Tailwind never generates the CSS for it.

Your fix (inline `style="background-image: url(...)"`) is the documented workaround for genuinely dynamic values; the doc's guidance is to avoid dynamically constructing class names and instead map to complete static classes or use inline styles for arbitrary/dynamic values.
